Verdict: approve.

Clean profile replicates across independent dose-response experiments. Significant effects observed across belzutifan concentrations of 31.6-100 nM and 3.16 μM, but not 10 nM. ## Reflection

High-dose acquisitions got the call right: 10 uM rep1 showed cell_area z=+12.0 and nuc_area z=+9.9, and 10 uM rep2 replicated even larger nuc_area z=+25.7 with nuc_major_axis z=+19.6 as large single round nuclei, with dose-dependent nuc_area Spearman rho=+1.00 and rising nuc_dna_integrated plus falling cell_count, and the first atlas match of DNA damage 6/10 directly supported DNA damage over mitotic or cytoskeletal classes (PMID 15380096, PMID 9746757).
